objective: Use the lowest-cost eligible builder while applying only the review pipeline required by the owner-declared repository and work type.

inventory_contract.source: The active controller supplies a current inventory of models it can execute.
inventory_contract.trust_boundary: Discovery establishes availability only; the owner-controlled inventory assigns capabilities and roles.

selection_policy.rule: Select builders by role and capability before cost; select every review stage from the strongest eligible high-reasoning model, distinct from the builder and preceding stages, preferring another provider.

core_rule: Code and content work use separate pipelines. Agent review selects the strongest eligible distinct model across providers at high reasoning; model final authority owns technical release readiness. Human review is not a release gate. Security is an additive code-only gate followed by final authority; no selected review pipeline may be skipped, self-reviewed, or silently downgraded. Publication remains an explicit owner-authorized action.
